# Who am I?

> A free web app for playing the classic "Who am I?" party guessing game
> remotely with friends and family. Players join a room by a six-character
> code or a link, give each other secret characters, then guess who they are.

Key facts:

- One player creates a room and shares its code or link; the others join from any phone or computer
- Each player writes a secret character on a tag pinned to another player's card; everyone sees the tags except their own
- Your own character stays in a sealed envelope until you reveal it; the game itself (questions and answers) is played by voice, at the table or on a video call
- A room keeps its players across a page reload or a short loss of connection
- English and Russian: the browser's language at first, switchable on the page
- Installable PWA; it needs a connection, since a room lives on the server
- No account or payment required

Note: the site's HTML is a form to join or create a room; it does not explain
the game — this file is the canonical plain-text description of the site.
